# MeedyaDL 1.0.0

The first stable release of MeedyaDL — a free, open-source desktop app for downloading your Apple Music library, for Mac, Windows, and Linux.

### What's new

- **A guided setup wizard** gets you going on first launch — MeedyaDL downloads and configures everything it needs (Python and the underlying downloader engine) automatically, no manual setup required.
- **Flexible audio quality**, including Lossless (ALAC), Dolby Atmos, and standard AAC, with an automatic fallback order — if your first choice isn't available for a track, MeedyaDL tries the next best option instead of failing outright.
- **Rich metadata and synced lyrics** are added automatically after each download: cover art, credits, and word-by-word synced lyrics where Apple Music provides them.
- **A real download queue** — paste one or many Apple Music links, watch live progress, and retry anything that fails.
- **Automatic updates**, so you're never stuck manually checking for a new version.
- Native installers for **macOS (Apple Silicon), Windows (Intel/AMD and ARM), and Linux** (including Raspberry Pi and Chromebook via Linux support).

### Notes

- This is a 1.0 milestone release: the culmination of the pre-release development that preceded it, marking MeedyaDL as stable and ready for everyday use.

_Full technical changelog: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/MWBMPartners/MeedyaDL/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)_
